result:
I’d make the cost of harming someone no longer disappear.

Not through punishment, not through surveillance, not by turning everyone into a saint. Just a change in the basic physics of relationships: when one person gains by using another—by their pain, time, bodies, trust, silence—the gains and the costs would remain connected. I’d make it impossible to treat another human being as a resource that can be spent, then forgotten.

If that one thing shifted, the world wouldn’t become perfect. But cruelty, exploitation, and indifference would become harder to repeat without at least one moment of having to meet what they’ve done.
